source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 755 adds Select All and Select None to the detected-calendar wizard. setCalendarsSelected skips disabled rows, and the accept handler registers only checked calendars that are not already registered. Native buttons invoke the helper with a boolean checked state. A bulk operation must follow the same eligibility as individual controls. No calendar-server or wizard UI run was performed.
title: Bulk calendar selection must skip disabled entries and apply the checked state on accept
